items.heading: Task-scoped evaluation metrics
items.body: Promotion comparison is no longer locked to one error metric across every pipeline. Each forecasting task can choose its own metric with frontend, backend, and ledger aligned.

items.heading: Manual promote from history
items.body: No need to wait for scheduled auto-promotion. Pin a registered version as production after the same contract checks as import; on failure, production stays unchanged.

items.heading: Production pin and unpin
items.body: While pinned, scheduled eval still runs but does not promote; new training does not auto-unpin. The UI shows a pin banner, history picker, and manual unpin.
